I made $10,000 selling this AI voice-agent workflow to businesses, and I'm going to give you the full exact workflow so you can print with it too.   This one workflow integrated with Vapi for the Agent helps businesses turn more leads into booked calls, increase sales efficiency, and make sure no qualified lead slips through the cracks.   this is how it works:  A lead comes in, the AI qualifies them, Vapi calls them, analyses the conversation, and updates the CRM automatically.   Phase one is simple.   A new lead gets added to Airtable, and the system only lets qualified leads through. So we're not wasting the voice agent on every person who fills out the form.   Phase two is where this gets interesting.   Make.com takes the lead's phone number and sends it to Vapi.   Vapi then actually calls them and asks about their business, what they're trying to achieve, and what they want help with.   Because Vapi uses ChatGPT 4.2 to engage with the prospect, It listens to what they say, responds to it, asks follow-up questions based on their answers, and works out whether they're a real fit, the same way a person would on a real qualifying call.   But the call itself still isn't the valuable part.   After the conversation finishes, Make waits, then sends an HTTP GET request to Vapi's API to retrieve the call record.   That gives us the transcript data, the call summary, and the analysis.   And here's the part that actually matters most to business owners.   With Vapi's integrated success rate, we can not only see whether or not the prospect picked up the phone, but also   whether they're an interested lead worth dialing immediately.   Vapi returns that as a simple true-or-false result, and that's the exact signal the router uses.   And this is where the automation saves business the most manual work.   When theyre interested Airtable updates with a call summary and interest level,  so the salesperson already has the most up-to-date details about the prospect before even picking up the phone.   And if they don't answer, the system doesn't just abandon the lead.   It falls back to email and alerts the sales team in Slack.   So businesses aren't just getting an AI-receptionist.   This is a system that takes a lead from qualification, to phone call, to qualification, to CRM update, without someone manually managing every step.   That's when an automation stops feeling like a tool and starts feeling like an actual AI teammate that doesn't let leads fall through the cracks.
